summary: Faith Family Academy urges preservation of E-Rate for urban public charter schools, emphasizing its role as an educational equity program for economically disadvantaged students. Faith Family Academy urges the FCC to preserve E-Rate as a national program for eligible public schools and libraries, emphasizing the importance of maintaining socioeconomic need as a primary consideration in determining E-Rate support. The organization requests that the FCC preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program to ensure that high-need urban public charter schools remain fully eligible to participate.
